LamBox.Empty:
  mutual inductive(s):
    Empty
    type variables:  []
      constructors:

Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat:
  mutual inductive(s):
    Nat
    type variables:  []
      constructors:
        zero (0 arg(s))
        suc (1 arg(s))
          n : Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}

Agda.Builtin.Nat._+_:
  constant declaration:
    type variables: []
    type: (Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}) → (Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}) → Agda.
                                                                  Builtin.
                                                                  Nat.Nat{0}
    body: μrec [0] :=
            0: λ _ _ →
                 case<Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0},0> @1 of
                   λ<[]> @0
                   λ<[_]> Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{1} (@3 @0 @1)

Product._×_:
  mutual inductive(s):
    _×_
    type variables:  [A, B]
      constructors:
        _,_ (2 arg(s))
          A : □
          B : □
          proj₁ : @0
          proj₂ : @1

Product._×_.proj₁:
  constant declaration:
    type variables: [A, B]
    type: Product._×_{0} @0 @1 → @0
    body: λ _ → case<Product._×_{0},2> @0 of λ<[_, _]> @1

Product._×_.proj₂:
  constant declaration:
    type variables: [A, B]
    type: Product._×_{0} @0 @1 → @1
    body: λ _ → case<Product._×_{0},2> @0 of λ<[_, _]> @0

Product.mapFst:
  constant declaration:
    type variables: [A, C, B]
    type: □ → □ → □ → (@0 → @1) → Product._×_{0} @0 @2 → Product._×_{0} @1 @2
    body: λ _ _ _ _ _ →
            case<Product._×_{0},2> @0 of
              λ<[_, _]> Product._×_{0}{0} □ □ (@3 @1) @0

Product.mapSnd:
  constant declaration:
    type variables: [B, C, A]
    type: □ → □ → □ → (@0 → @1) → Product._×_{0} @2 @0 → Product._×_{0} @2 @1
    body: λ _ _ _ _ _ →
            case<Product._×_{0},2> @0 of
              λ<[_, _]> Product._×_{0}{0} □ □ @1 (@3 @0)
